# One link fault, two verdicts: build exits 1 — the diagnostics are
# its product — while run exits 2, because under run the broken
# solution is the invocation's input and nothing wet has happened;
# restarting reproduces it. The diagnostic stays positioned at the
# offending source either way.
[short] skip 'drives the go toolchain'

exec go mod edit -replace=github.com/modern-engineering/prototype=$SDLREPO
cp $SDLREPO/go.sum go.sum
status 1 sdl build
stderr 'sol\.sdl:5:8: unknown element Gone'
status 2 sdl run
stderr 'sol\.sdl:5:8: unknown element Gone'
! stdout .

-- go.mod --
module example.test/sol

go 1.25.0

require github.com/modern-engineering/prototype v0.0.0
-- sol.sdl --
solution broken

import ff "github.com/modern-engineering/prototype/examples/ff"

deploy ff.Gone as G
